notes.title: Update for September 6th - Camera and Menu Changes
notes.notes:
Added option to move camera around while on Ludus management screen. Hold right mouse button to look around. 

Removed quit to main menu for now. Will add back later but for now it was causing issues with the fighters. Now quit to desktop to restart. 

Other minor gameplay and bugs fixes 
 
Less experience needed to level up 
Issues with skill menu not disappearing on window close
